meta.name: deduplicate
meta.description: Deduplicate prospect lists, merge data from multiple sources, and ensure data quality across columns. Use when user asks about "deduplicate", "duplicates", "remove duplicates", "merge sources", "merge columns", "multiple data sources", "data quality", "clean up list", "duplicate contacts", "Clay auto-dedupe". Do NOT use for email verification (use clean-validate) or ICP scoring (use define-icp).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 合并并去重多个来源的客户数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天要处理来自不同平台的重复客户记录
copy.tagline_en: Merge and deduplicate customer data from multiple sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you daily deal with duplicate customer records from different platforms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能自动识别并删除重复联系人，合并来自多个数据源的同一人信息，并检查数据质量（如空邮箱、个人邮箱等）。它会优先建议使用ColdIQ生成干净列表，否则提供手工去重合并步骤。
howto.when: 当用户提到“去重”、“合并数据源”、“清理名单”等关键词时触发。不用于邮箱验证或ICP评分。

say.text: 我导入了Apollo和Sales Nav的名单，有很多重复，帮我清理。
say.note: Claude会识别重复并合并数据。

say.text: 如何合并来自三个不同供应商的邮箱列？
怎样避免在不同营销活动中重复联系同一个人？
say.note: Claude会建议建立全局排除列表。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude helps automatically detect and remove duplicate contacts, merge data from multiple sources for the same person, and check data quality (empty emails, personal emails, etc.). It recommends using ColdIQ for a clean list first, otherwise provides manual dedup/merge steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions "deduplicate", "merge sources", "clean up list", or similar keywords. Not for email verification or ICP scoring.

say_en.text: I imported leads from Apollo and Sales Nav, tons of duplicates. Help clean up.
say_en.note: Claude will identify duplicates and merge data.

say_en.text: How do I merge email columns from three different providers?
How to avoid contacting the same person across campaigns?
say_en.note: Claude suggests building a master suppression list.
